Hm? Ooh...nothing.
For some reason...I was just wondering if the\nvillage Mubandi and Bibia lived in was like this\ntoo...
Whoa~, I don't think we can get through...\nWhat should we do?
Although they are from the Imperial Dragon\nfaction, they are just weredragons like Zianga.\nYou don't wanna hurt them if possible...
You don't wanna hurt them? How are we going to\nsave the people in the village then?!
I don't think they care about what we think,\nso it's fine to beat them!
But there are so many of them, if we attack\ncarelessly, things could turn messy later...
Excuse me...
Oh my gosh, you scared me!\nBibia, what are you doing here?
Yes...After losing my lover, Mubandi, in the\nbattle in the cockpit, I was overcome with grief\nand I came here, but...
Soon the minions of the Imperial Dragon came to\nattack and the weredragons of the Imperial Dragon\nfaction revolted. They occupied the village and
captured the chief. So, the villagers and I took\nrefuge underground...But, we get attacked by small\ndragons too there, so I came out to get help...
Wait, the fact that you came out here means there\nis another way other than the village entrance?
Yes, the passage to the underground shelter...\nis also connected to the center of the village...
Bibia, can you show us the way?
Sure, follow me this way then...
